### constructing switch tables  {.smaller}


* could have system administrator input these by hand 

   * through an SSH-like interface, probably

* works, but error-prone, hard to change, etc. 
<hr class="vspace" />
* alternative: switch should figure it out


### key trick: backup plan  {.smaller}


* Ethernet designed for multi-access
* can simulate that by broadcasting all frames 
<hr class="vspace" />
* what to do if switch table is incomplete?
* just broadcast to everyone!
